about.text_02: Tellen Finance was founded by Stephan Coetsee, a Chartered Accountant (South Africa), CA(SA), with experience in audit, technical accounting and international group finance.
about.text_03: Stephan previously worked in Accounting and Reporting Advisory at Deloitte Netherlands, advising on IFRS, Dutch GAAP, US GAAP, reporting conversions, complex transactions and audit readiness.
about.text_04: His international finance leadership experience includes financial reporting and consolidation, financial planning and analysis, budgets and forecasts, financial control and commercial performance.
about.text_05: Tellen is an independent practice. Stephan personally scopes and delivers client engagements, agrees deliverables and fees upfront, and remains the direct point of contact throughout.
about.text_06: CA(SA), Chartered Accountant, with audit and advisory experience.
about.text_07: Previous Deloitte advisory experience in IFRS, Dutch GAAP, conversions and technical accounting.
about.text_08: International finance leadership, reporting, consolidation, FP&A and financial control.
about.text_09: Direct personal involvement in each engagement, from scope through agreed deliverables.
